notes.title: Small Demo Patch
notes.content:
A small patch arrives, aiming to improve the experience with the demo. Changes include:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to rebind the weapon wheel to a different key,
[*] Removed certain actions from being rebound temporarily.
[*] Added a note to inform users to double-click when attempting to change a keybind.
[*] Added horizontal and vertical look toggles.
[*] Fixed sensitivity bug.
[*] Modified recoil system.
[*] and a few other minor updates.

[/list]

If you encounter any other issues, please be sure to let us know.
